facts.fact: Djibouti customs (DGDDI) states that from 2 September 2025 free-zone operators and forwarders register and clear IM7 and EX3 declarations in SYDONIAWorld, with customs and stamp fees debited from prepayment accounts.

systems.owner: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects

facts.fact: Djibouti customs states that free-zone operators and forwarders enter their taxpayer number (NIF) in box 48 of IM7 and EX3 customs declarations in SYDONIAWorld.
